summary: The change sends workspace inference to Together first and falls back to Vertex Gemini on 429/5xx or a connection failure that happens before streaming starts. Gemini requests get adapted tool history, and provider headers stay private. All 55 durable tests pass, and the coverage gate passes: every changed line is covered, or exempt with a reason I accept (process entry point, declarative Pulumi, best-effort body cancel). F1 (stream failure not logged) and F2 (failing durable test) are both resolved.
